fusions.name: Link by Link
fusions.desc: Fires a string of linked polyps that deals 11 poison damage to the first enemy it meets and stuns it for 0.8 seconds. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Reeled Under
fusions.desc: Lashes a coral-weighted line at an enemy up to 6 tiles away for 22 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Drag-Line
fusions.desc: Grows a 6-tile line of linked coral for 5 seconds that drags enemies toward it, and slows each one it catches by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Ring-Mail Reef
fusions.desc: Conjures a mail of linked coral rings: every hit you take is 3 lower, your armour rises by 12%, and 5% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
